mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction above 500 thousand units signals strong housing market demand, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% for three consecutive months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market weakening, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 100.0 and UNRATE < 6.0%), overheating signals potential policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
